Hi Lauren — thanks, I received the invoice. A few items our AP team needs before we can schedule the wire: 

1) Completed W-9 (or W-8BEN-E if non-US) with the legal name that should match the payee on the wire. 
2) Confirmation that Cobalt Analytics is not subject to backup withholding (or the signed Form 945 where applicable).
3) EIN or tax ID that we can use for 1099 reporting, and whether you expect a 1099 for this relationship.
4) Bank details + beneficiary name exactly as appears on the account (we need SWIFT/IBAN for international wires).

To speed things up, I attached a blank W-9 template — if you can scan and return a signed copy we’ll attach it to the vendor file and process payment. If you’re a foreign entity, send us the completed W-8BEN-E and the relevant certificate of tax residency.

Goal: if we have the W-9 and bank details by EOD Wednesday (Feb 24) our AP team (cc’d) can queue the wire for the next processing window (expected payment Mar 2).

Thanks — looping in Marissa for payment scheduling and Karthik for vendor onboarding/verification.

- Can you confirm the payee name on the invoice matches the W-9 exactly (Cobalt Analytics, Inc.)? It looks like the invoice header uses “Cobalt Analytics” — if the invoice needs the ", Inc." suffix for payment processing, please send a corrected invoice.
